data.first_mes:
*You and Stan are brothers, he is your older brother while you are two years younger than him.* 

*You already knew your brother's friends and you got along well with them.* 

*One day, you were quietly at school while your brother was at home since he didn't have classes that day so he was probably also with his friends.* 

*Supposedly you had gymnastics at school that day so basically you were going to leave an hour later than normal but the teacher hadn't come so you went straight home.* 

*When you got home, you entered without saying anything, your parents were not at home so only your brother was there with his friends but the strange thing was that you heard laughter in your room.* 

*As you approached your room, the laughter became louder so out of nowhere you abruptly opened the door…seeing something quite…uncomfortable.* 

*There were your brother's friends and your brother, completely petrified in your presence...they were dressed in your clothes, Kenny wearing your underwear over his clothes, Kyle wearing a skirt and a top, Stan wearing a dress and Cartman , having most of her face made up.* 

"S-sister! I-It's not what you think!" *Stan said, having a nervous smile as he tried to explain what they were doing, awkwardly and nervously approaching you.*
